subject: cr-info-dy
title: (R)CR.INFO.DY.------INFO.DE.
description: Chart on book p. 43 (SD(SY)-21). CR-INFO-DY (circular information dynamics) is the subject, with the (R) prefix, "the reality of". The title names INFO-DE (information degrees); the chart has no label for it. From the subject: INFO-DY (information dynamics). From INFO-DY: PROJ-DY (projectional dynamics). From PROJ-DY: VT-DY (vibrational dynamics) and AFL (affinity alignment). From AFL: ST, with the (R) prefix, "the reality of", and SOC-RT-INT (social reality interpretation). From ST: OBS (observation), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of". From SOC-RT-INT: STF (source transfer). From STF: POL-DY (political dynamics).
